@@ -0,0 +1,482 @@
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.Sandwich.Support
+
+/-!
+# Completion on a prescribed set of outcomes
+
+This formalization-only auxiliary constructs a complete measurement supported on
+the good outcomes of a finite measurement, by sending every bad outcome to a
+specified good outcome. For projective measurements this adds the complementary
+projection to the default effect and preserves projectivity. The consistency
+estimates charge changes of outcome labels only to the state mass of that
+complementary projection, on either of two possibly different player spaces.
+
+The source-specific estimate on the mass outside the image of the polynomial
+combining map is the unimplemented target `global_polynomial_bad_mass_le`,
+specified in `audits/2026-09-06_supported-projective-completion.md` under issue #279.
+No result here asserts the global polynomial-pair theorem or derives that estimate.
+
+## References
+
+* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1364-1402`,
+  the completion step after `eq:qld-sgg-mhat-sandwich` in `lem:qld-4-7`.
+* Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`, whose source theorem remains separate from this auxiliary.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.SupportedCompletion
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum
+open DistanceCalculus
+
+variable {α β X ι ιA ιB : Type*}
+variable [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
+variable [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
+variable [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+variable [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
+
+/-- Retain every good outcome and send every other outcome to the specified
+good outcome. The default is actual domain data, with its membership proof. -/
+def toGood (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (a₀ : {a // good a}) (a : α) : {a // good a} :=
+  if h : good a then ⟨a, h⟩ else a₀
+
+omit [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] in
+@[simp] theorem toGood_coe (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (a₀ a : {a // good a}) : toGood good a₀ a = a := by
+  simp [toGood, a.property]
+
+/-- The omitted effects. When the measurement is projective, their sum is the
+projection complementary to the sum of good effects. -/
+noncomputable def badEffect (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] : Op ι :=
+  ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => ¬ good a), M.effect a
+
+/-- Complete the restriction to good outcomes by adding all bad effects to
+`a₀`. This is an outcome postprocessing of the original complete measurement. -/
+noncomputable def complete (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (a₀ : {a // good a}) :
+    Measurement {a // good a} ι :=
+  M.postprocess (toGood good a₀)
+
+/-- The completion is projective whenever the original measurement is
+projective, by projectivity of outcome postprocessing. -/
+theorem complete_isProjective (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (hM : Measurement.IsProjective M) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (a₀ : {a // good a}) : Measurement.IsProjective (complete M good a₀) :=
+  SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective M hM (toGood good a₀)
+
+omit [DecidableEq α] in
+/-- The bad effect is precisely the complement of the restricted total. -/
+theorem badEffect_eq_one_sub (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] :
+    badEffect M good = 1 - ∑ a : {a // good a}, M.effect a := by
+  have hsplit := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype good M.effect
+  have hbad : badEffect M good = ∑ a : {a // ¬ good a}, M.effect a := by
+    exact Finset.sum_subtype _ (by simp) M.effect
+  rw [hbad]
+  rw [M.sum_eq_one] at hsplit
+  exact eq_sub_of_add_eq' hsplit
+
+omit [DecidableEq α] in
+/-- The sum of the omitted effects is positive semidefinite. -/
+theorem badEffect_nonneg (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] : 0 ≤ badEffect M good :=
+  Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => M.pos a
+
+/-- The submeasurement obtained by retaining only the good outcomes. -/
+noncomputable def restrict (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] : Submeasurement {a // good a} ι where
+  effect a := M.effect a
+  pos a := M.pos a
+  sum_le_one := by
+    have h := badEffect_nonneg M good
+    rw [badEffect_eq_one_sub] at h
+    exact sub_nonneg.mp h
+
+/-- The bad effect is itself a projection: it is one effect of the binary
+postprocessing recording whether an outcome is bad. -/
+theorem badEffect_isStarProjection (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (hM : Measurement.IsProjective M) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] :
+    IsStarProjection (badEffect M good) := by
+  have h := SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective M hM
+    (fun a => decide (¬ good a)) true
+  change IsStarProjection (∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter
+    (fun a => decide (¬ good a) = true), M.effect a) at h
+  simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq, badEffect] using h
+
+/-- The completed default effect absorbs exactly the omitted projection;
+all other good effects are retained. -/
+theorem complete_effect (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (a₀ a : {a // good a}) :
+    (complete M good a₀).effect a =
+      M.effect a + if a = a₀ then badEffect M good else 0 := by
+  classical
+  rw [complete, Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
+  have hterm (b : α) :
+      (if toGood good a₀ b = a then M.effect b else 0) =
+        (if b = a.val then M.effect b else 0) +
+          if a = a₀ then (if ¬ good b then M.effect b else 0) else 0 := by
+    by_cases hb : good b
+    · have heq : toGood good a₀ b = a ↔ b = a.val := by
+        simp [toGood, hb, Subtype.ext_iff]
+      simp [heq, hb]
+    · have hba : b ≠ a.val := by
+        rintro rfl
+        exact hb a.property
+      simp [toGood, hb, hba, eq_comm]
+  simp_rw [hterm]
+  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
+  simp [badEffect, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_ite_irrel]
+
+/-- Relabeling the completed measurement adds the bad effect to exactly the
+label of the chosen default outcome, relative to the relabeled restriction. -/
+theorem complete_postprocess_effect (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (a₀ : {a // good a})
+    (g : {a // good a} → β) (b : β) :
+    ((complete M good a₀).postprocess g).effect b =
+      ((restrict M good).postprocess g).effect b +
+        if b = g a₀ then badEffect M good else 0 := by
+  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
+  simp_rw [complete_effect]
+  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
+  congr 1
+  simp [eq_comm]
+
+private theorem postprocess_overlap (M : Measurement α ι) (N : Measurement β ι)
+    (f : α → β) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
+    (∑ b, stateQForm ψ ((M.postprocess f).effect b * N.effect b)) =
+      ∑ a, stateQForm ψ (M.effect a * N.effect (f a)) := by
+  simp only [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_mul,
+    stateQForm_finset_sum]
+  calc
+    (∑ b, ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b),
+        stateQForm ψ (M.effect a * N.effect b)) =
+      ∑ b, ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b),
+        stateQForm ψ (M.effect a * N.effect (f a)) := by
+          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+          intro b _
+          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+          intro a ha
+          rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2]
+    _ = _ := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f _
+
+private theorem postprocess_defect (μ : Distribution X) (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ι) (f : X → α → β) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
+    consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => (M.postprocess (f x)).effect a)
+        (fun x a => (N x).effect a) ψ =
+      avgOver μ (fun x => ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 -
+        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ (M.effect a * (N x).effect (f x a))) := by
+  unfold consistencyDefect
+  simp_rw [consistency_term_eq_stateQForm, point_defect_eq, postprocess_overlap]
+
+private theorem leftPlaced_postprocess (M : Measurement α ιA) (f : α → β) :
+    leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ιB) (M.postprocess f) =
+      (leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ιB) M).postprocess f := by
+  apply MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ext
+  intro b
+  exact heteroKron_finset_sum_left _ _ _
+
+private theorem rightPlaced_postprocess (M : Measurement α ιB) (f : α → β) :
+    rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := ιA) (M.postprocess f) =
+      (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := ιA) M).postprocess f := by
+  apply MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ext
+  intro b
+  exact heteroKron_finset_sum_right _ _ _
+
+private theorem left_postprocess_defect (μ : Distribution X) (M : Measurement α ιA)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιB) (f : X → α → β)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => heteroKron ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect a)) ψ =
+      avgOver μ (fun x => ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 -
+        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (M.effect a) ((N x).effect (f x a)))) := by
+  change consistencyDefect μ
+    (fun x a => (leftPlacedMeasurement (M.postprocess (f x))).effect a)
+    (fun x a => (rightPlacedMeasurement (N x)).effect a) ψ = _
+  simp_rw [leftPlaced_postprocess]
+  rw [postprocess_defect]
+  simp only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement,
+    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne, placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
+
+private theorem right_postprocess_defect (μ : Distribution X) (M : Measurement α ιB)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιA) (f : X → α → β)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a))
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ =
+      avgOver μ (fun x => ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 -
+        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ (heteroKron ((N x).effect (f x a)) (M.effect a))) := by
+  change consistencyDefect μ
+    (fun x a => (rightPlacedMeasurement (M.postprocess (f x))).effect a)
+    (fun x a => (leftPlacedMeasurement (N x)).effect a) ψ = _
+  simp_rw [rightPlaced_postprocess]
+  rw [postprocess_defect]
+  simp only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement,
+    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne, heteroKron_mul, one_mul, mul_one]
+
+omit [DecidableEq α] [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] in
+/-- Equal good-outcome contributions cancel; the remaining averaged change
+is bounded by the sum of the bad-outcome upper bounds. -/
+private theorem abs_avg_sum_change_le (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (u v : X → α → ℝ) (r : α → ℝ)
+    (hu : ∀ x a, 0 ≤ u x a ∧ u x a ≤ r a)
+    (hv : ∀ x a, 0 ≤ v x a ∧ v x a ≤ r a)
+    (huv : ∀ x a, good a → u x a = v x a) (c : ℝ) :
+    |avgOver μ (fun x => c - ∑ a, u x a) -
+        avgOver μ (fun x => c - ∑ a, v x a)| ≤
+      ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => ¬ good a), r a := by
+  have hpoint (x : X) :
+      |(c - ∑ a, u x a) - (c - ∑ a, v x a)| ≤
+        ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => ¬ good a), r a := by
+    have hterm (a : α) : |v x a - u x a| ≤ if ¬ good a then r a else 0 := by
+      by_cases ha : good a
+      · simp [ha, huv x a ha]
+      · rw [if_pos ha]
+        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [(hu x a).2, (hv x a).1],
+          by linarith [(hv x a).2, (hu x a).1]⟩
+    calc
+      _ = |∑ a, (v x a - u x a)| := by
+        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
+        congr 1
+        ring
+      _ ≤ ∑ a, |v x a - u x a| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
+      _ ≤ ∑ a, if ¬ good a then r a else 0 :=
+        Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => hterm a
+      _ = _ := (Finset.sum_filter _ _).symm
+  rw [← avgOver_sub]
+  calc
+    _ ≤ avgOver μ (fun x => |(c - ∑ a, u x a) - (c - ∑ a, v x a)|) := by
+      unfold avgOver
+      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans_eq ?_
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro x _
+      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (μ.nonnegative x)]
+    _ ≤ avgOver μ (fun _ =>
+        ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => ¬ good a), r a) :=
+      avgOver_mono μ _ _ hpoint
+    _ = _ := avgOver_const_of_isProbability μ hμ _
+
+/-- Relabelings that agree on good outcomes change Alice-first cross-player
+consistency by at most Alice's bad-outcome state mass. The spaces may differ,
+the other measurement need not be projective, and the state may be unnormalized.
+This auxiliary isolates the quantitative content of the source completion step. -/
+theorem abs_postprocess_consistency_left_sub_le
+    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιA)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιB) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (f g : X → α → β) (hfg : ∀ x a, good a → f x a = g x a)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    |consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect a)) ψ -
+      consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((M.postprocess (g x)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect a)) ψ| ≤
+      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (badEffect M good) (1 : Op ιB)) := by
+  rw [left_postprocess_defect, left_postprocess_defect]
+  simp only [badEffect, heteroKron_finset_sum_left, stateQForm_finset_sum]
+  have hbound (x : X) (a : α) (b : β) :
+      0 ≤ stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (M.effect a) ((N x).effect b)) ∧
+        stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (M.effect a) ((N x).effect b)) ≤
+          stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (M.effect a) (1 : Op ιB)) :=
+    ⟨stateQForm_nonneg ψ (kronecker_nonneg (M.pos a) ((N x).pos b)),
+      quadratic_form_mono
+        (kronecker_le_kronecker_right_one (M.pos a) (measurement_effect_le_one (N x) b)) ψ⟩
+  exact abs_avg_sum_change_le μ hμ good _ _ _
+    (fun x a => hbound x a (f x a)) (fun x a => hbound x a (g x a))
+    (fun x a ha => by rw [hfg x a ha]) _
+
+/-- Relabelings that agree on good outcomes change Bob-first cross-player
+consistency by at most Bob's bad-outcome state mass. The completed measurement
+is the first consistency argument, although it acts on the right tensor factor;
+this is the orientation of the Bob conclusion of `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
+theorem abs_postprocess_consistency_right_sub_le
+    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιB)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιA) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (f g : X → α → β) (hfg : ∀ x a, good a → f x a = g x a)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    |consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a))
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ -
+      consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((M.postprocess (g x)).effect a))
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ| ≤
+      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (badEffect M good)) := by
+  rw [right_postprocess_defect, right_postprocess_defect]
+  simp only [badEffect, heteroKron_finset_sum_right, stateQForm_finset_sum]
+  have hbound (x : X) (a : α) (b : β) :
+      0 ≤ stateQForm ψ (heteroKron ((N x).effect b) (M.effect a)) ∧
+        stateQForm ψ (heteroKron ((N x).effect b) (M.effect a)) ≤
+          stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (M.effect a)) :=
+    ⟨stateQForm_nonneg ψ (kronecker_nonneg ((N x).pos b) (M.pos a)),
+      quadratic_form_mono
+        (kronecker_mono_left (measurement_effect_le_one (N x) b) (M.pos a)) ψ⟩
+  exact abs_avg_sum_change_le μ hμ good _ _ _
+    (fun x a => hbound x a (f x a)) (fun x a => hbound x a (g x a))
+    (fun x a ha => by rw [hfg x a ha]) _
+
+/-- After any outcome maps agreeing on the good outcomes, the constructed
+completion changes Alice-first consistency by at most the bad projection's
+state mass. Together with `complete_isProjective`, this is the finite-measurement
+adapter for the completion step of `lem:qld-4-7`, not its source mass estimate. -/
+theorem abs_complete_consistency_left_sub_le
+    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιA)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιB) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (a₀ : {a // good a}) (f : X → α → β) (g : X → {a // good a} → β)
+    (hgf : ∀ x a, g x a = f x a) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    |consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron (((complete M good a₀).postprocess (g x)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect a)) ψ -
+      consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect a)) ψ| ≤
+      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (badEffect M good) (1 : Op ιB)) := by
+  simp only [complete, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_comp]
+  apply abs_postprocess_consistency_left_sub_le μ hμ M N good _ f _ ψ
+  intro x a ha
+  simpa only [toGood, dif_pos ha] using hgf x ⟨a, ha⟩
+
+/-- The same completion estimate with the completed measurement on Bob's
+space, still as the first argument of consistency. Both player spaces and the
+order of the tensor factors remain explicit. -/
+theorem abs_complete_consistency_right_sub_le
+    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιB)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιA) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (a₀ : {a // good a}) (f : X → α → β) (g : X → {a // good a} → β)
+    (hgf : ∀ x a, g x a = f x a) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    |consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (((complete M good a₀).postprocess (g x)).effect a))
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ -
+      consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a))
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ| ≤
+      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (badEffect M good)) := by
+  simp only [complete, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_comp]
+  apply abs_postprocess_consistency_right_sub_le μ hμ M N good _ f _ ψ
+  intro x a ha
+  simpa only [toGood, dif_pos ha] using hgf x ⟨a, ha⟩
+
+/-- Adding one fixed operator at a question-dependent outcome changes the
+defect by its total state mass minus the overlap at that outcome. -/
+private theorem add_at_outcome_defect (μ : Distribution X)
+    (A : X → β → Op ι) (N : X → Measurement β ι)
+    (R : Op ι) (k : X → β) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
+    consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => A x a + if a = k x then R else 0)
+        (fun x a => (N x).effect a) ψ =
+      consistencyDefect μ A (fun x a => (N x).effect a) ψ +
+        avgOver μ (fun x => stateQForm ψ R - stateQForm ψ (R * (N x).effect (k x))) := by
+  unfold consistencyDefect
+  simp_rw [consistency_term_eq_stateQForm]
+  have hpoint (x : X) :
+      (∑ a, ∑ b, if a = b then 0 else
+        stateQForm ψ ((A x a + if a = k x then R else 0) * (N x).effect b)) =
+      (∑ a, ∑ b, if a = b then 0 else stateQForm ψ (A x a * (N x).effect b)) +
+        (stateQForm ψ R - stateQForm ψ (R * (N x).effect (k x))) := by
+    have hterm (a b : β) :
+        (if a = b then 0 else
+          stateQForm ψ ((A x a + if a = k x then R else 0) * (N x).effect b)) =
+        (if a = b then 0 else stateQForm ψ (A x a * (N x).effect b)) +
+          if a = k x then
+            (if a = b then 0 else stateQForm ψ (R * (N x).effect b)) else 0 := by
+      by_cases hab : a = b
+      · simp only [hab, if_true, ite_self, add_zero]
+      · simp only [hab, if_false]
+        by_cases ha : a = k x <;> simp [ha, add_mul, stateQForm_add]
+    simp_rw [hterm, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
+    congr 1
+    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
+    rw [Finset.sum_ite]
+    simp only [Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
+    rw [show Finset.univ.filter (fun b => ¬ k x = b) = Finset.univ.erase (k x) by
+      ext b
+      simp [ne_comm]]
+    rw [Finset.sum_erase_eq_sub (Finset.mem_univ _),
+      ← stateQForm_finset_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
+      (N x).sum_eq_one, mul_one]
+  simp_rw [hpoint]
+  exact avgOver_add μ _ _
+
+/-- Completing the good restriction and then relabeling increases Alice-first
+consistency by at most the bad-effect mass. This directly applies to the
+submeasurement relation preceding completion in the source; projectivity of the
+constructed complete measurement is supplied by `complete_isProjective`. -/
+theorem complete_restrict_consistency_left_le
+    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιA)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιB) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (a₀ : {a // good a}) (g : X → {a // good a} → β)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron (((complete M good a₀).postprocess (g x)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect a)) ψ ≤
+      consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron (((restrict M good).postprocess (g x)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect a)) ψ +
+      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (badEffect M good) (1 : Op ιB)) := by
+  have heffect (x : X) (a : β) :
+      heteroKron (((complete M good a₀).postprocess (g x)).effect a) (1 : Op ιB) =
+        heteroKron (((restrict M good).postprocess (g x)).effect a) 1 +
+          if a = g x a₀ then heteroKron (badEffect M good) 1 else 0 := by
+    rw [complete_postprocess_effect, heteroKron_add_left]
+    by_cases h : a = g x a₀ <;> simp [h, heteroKron]
+  simp_rw [heffect]
+  have hdefect := add_at_outcome_defect μ
+    (fun x a => heteroKron (((restrict M good).postprocess (g x)).effect a) 1)
+    (fun x => rightPlacedMeasurement (N x))
+    (heteroKron (badEffect M good) 1) (fun x => g x a₀) ψ
+  dsimp only [rightPlacedMeasurement, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] at hdefect
+  rw [hdefect]
+  apply add_le_add le_rfl
+  calc
+    _ ≤ avgOver μ (fun _ => stateQForm ψ
+        (heteroKron (badEffect M good) (1 : Op ιB))) := by
+      apply avgOver_mono
+      intro x
+      apply sub_le_self
+      change 0 ≤ stateQForm ψ
+        (heteroKron (badEffect M good) 1 * heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect (g x a₀)))
+      rw [placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
+      exact stateQForm_nonneg ψ (kronecker_nonneg (badEffect_nonneg M good) ((N x).pos _))
+    _ = _ := avgOver_const_of_isProbability μ hμ _
+
+/-- The direct restriction-to-completion estimate with the completed
+measurement on Bob's space and first in the consistency relation. -/
+theorem complete_restrict_consistency_right_le
+    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιB)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιA) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (a₀ : {a // good a}) (g : X → {a // good a} → β)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (((complete M good a₀).postprocess (g x)).effect a))
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ ≤
+      consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (((restrict M good).postprocess (g x)).effect a))
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ +
+      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (badEffect M good)) := by
+  have heffect (x : X) (a : β) :
+      heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (((complete M good a₀).postprocess (g x)).effect a) =
+        heteroKron 1 (((restrict M good).postprocess (g x)).effect a) +
+          if a = g x a₀ then heteroKron 1 (badEffect M good) else 0 := by
+    rw [complete_postprocess_effect, heteroKron_add_right]
+    by_cases h : a = g x a₀ <;> simp [h, heteroKron]
+  simp_rw [heffect]
+  have hdefect := add_at_outcome_defect μ
+    (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (((restrict M good).postprocess (g x)).effect a))
+    (fun x => leftPlacedMeasurement (N x))
+    (heteroKron 1 (badEffect M good)) (fun x => g x a₀) ψ
+  dsimp only [leftPlacedMeasurement, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] at hdefect
+  rw [hdefect]
+  apply add_le_add le_rfl
+  calc
+    _ ≤ avgOver μ (fun _ => stateQForm ψ
+        (heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (badEffect M good))) := by
+      apply avgOver_mono
+      intro x
+      apply sub_le_self
+      change 0 ≤ stateQForm ψ
+        (heteroKron 1 (badEffect M good) * heteroKron ((N x).effect (g x a₀)) 1)
+      rw [heteroKron_mul, one_mul, mul_one]
+      exact stateQForm_nonneg ψ (kronecker_nonneg ((N x).pos _) (badEffect_nonneg M good))
+    _ = _ := avgOver_const_of_isProbability μ hμ _
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT.SupportedCompletion

     3	/-! # Ground-coordinate compression of finite measurements
     4	
     5	For a distinguished ancilla coordinate `k₀`, `groundCompressMeasurement k₀ M`
     6	has effects `M.effect a (i, k₀) (j, k₀)`. Positivity and completeness descend
     7	to this principal submatrix. Compression commutes with finite outcome
     8	postprocessing and preserves bipartite consistency exactly on `padState`.
     9	The two players' spaces and their ancilla spaces may all be different.
    10	
    11	These are Lean-only auxiliaries for the two Naimark steps in the proof of
    12	`lem:qld-4-7`, tracked by issue #277. They allow measurements on the enlarged
    13	spaces to be compared on the original spaces, including after polynomial
    14	evaluation. Compression does not in general preserve projectivity; obtaining
    15	projective measurements on the original spaces requires a separate rounding
    16	argument. No statement of `lem:qld-4-7` is formalized here.
    17	
    18	## References
    19	
    20	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1278-1288`,
    21	  the two Naimark steps in the proof of `lem:qld-4-7`.
    22	* `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`,
    23	  `def:consistency`.
    24	-/

    35	variable {α β I K : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    36	  [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]

    38	/-- Compress every effect of a finite POVM to the coordinate `k₀` of its
    39	ancilla. This is the POVM with effects `J† M_a J`, where `J` inserts `k₀`.
    40	Positivity follows from `Matrix.PosSemidef.submatrix`, and completeness from
    41	the injectivity of the coordinate inclusion. -/
    42	def groundCompressMeasurement (k₀ : K) (M : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) :
    43	    Quantum.Measurement α I :=
    44	  Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    45	    (fun a => (M.effect a).submatrix (fun i => (i, k₀)) (fun i => (i, k₀)))
    46	    (fun a => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
    47	      ((Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (M.pos a)).submatrix _)) <| by
    48	    ext i j
    49	    simpa [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using
    50	      congrArg (fun T : Op (I × K) => T (i, k₀) (j, k₀)) M.sum_eq_one
    51	
    52	/-- The compressed effect is the principal submatrix at `k₀`. -/
    53	@[simp] theorem ground_compress_measurement_effect
    54	    (k₀ : K) (M : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) (a : α) (i j : I) :
    55	    (groundCompressMeasurement k₀ M).effect a i j =
    56	      M.effect a (i, k₀) (j, k₀) := rfl
    57	
    58	/-- Ground-coordinate compression commutes with arbitrary finite relabeling
    59	of outcomes, since taking a submatrix commutes with each fiber sum. -/
    60	@[simp] theorem ground_compress_measurement_postprocess
    61	    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    62	    (k₀ : K) (M : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) (f : α → β) :
    63	    groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (M.postprocess f) =
    64	      (groundCompressMeasurement k₀ M).postprocess f := by
    65	  apply Quantum.Measurement.ext
    66	  intro b
    67	  ext i j
    68	  simp only [ground_compress_measurement_effect, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    69	    Matrix.sum_apply]

    80	/-- Every bipartite outcome correlation on the independently padded state
    81	equals the correlation of the compressed POVMs on the original state.
    82	Neither normalization nor equality of the player spaces is required. -/
    83	theorem vector_qform_ground_compress_measurement
    84	    (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
    85	    (A : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) (B : Quantum.Measurement β (J × L))
    86	    (a : α) (b : β) :
    87	    vectorQForm (padState k₀ l₀ ψ) (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect b)) =
    88	      vectorQForm ψ (heteroKron
    89	        ((groundCompressMeasurement k₀ A).effect a)
    90	        ((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ B).effect b)) := by

    93	/-- The averaged off-diagonal consistency defect is exactly preserved by

    96	theorem consistency_defect_ground_compress_measurement [DecidableEq α]
    97	    (μ : Distribution X) (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
    98	    (A : X → Quantum.Measurement α (I × K))
    99	    (B : X → Quantum.Measurement α (J × L)) :
   100	    consistencyDefect μ
   101	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).effect a) 1)
   102	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect a)) (padState k₀ l₀ ψ) =
   103	      consistencyDefect μ
   104	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (A x)).effect a) 1)
   105	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ (B x)).effect a)) ψ := by
   106	  unfold consistencyDefect
   107	  apply avgOver_congr
   108	  intro x
   109	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   110	  intro a _
   111	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   112	  intro b _
   113	  split_ifs with hab
   114	  · rfl
   115	  · simp only [heteroKron_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
   116	    exact vector_qform_ground_compress_measurement k₀ l₀ ψ (A x) (B x) a b
   117	
   118	/-- A consistency bound holds on the independently padded state if and only
   119	if the same bound holds for the compressed measurements on the original state. -/
   120	theorem is_consistent_within_ground_compress_measurement_iff [DecidableEq α]
   121	    (μ : Distribution X) (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   122	    (A : X → Quantum.Measurement α (I × K))
   123	    (B : X → Quantum.Measurement α (J × L)) (δ : ℝ) :
   124	    IsConsistentWithin μ
   125	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).effect a) 1)
   126	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect a)) (padState k₀ l₀ ψ) δ ↔
   127	      IsConsistentWithin μ
   128	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (A x)).effect a) 1)
   129	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ (B x)).effect a)) ψ δ := by
   130	  unfold IsConsistentWithin
   131	  rw [consistency_defect_ground_compress_measurement]

   133	/-- Exact consistency preservation also holds after question-dependent
   134	postprocessing. The original outcome types and the two outcome maps may
   135	differ; only the final outcome alphabet is shared. In the application to
   136	`lem:qld-4-7`, these maps include evaluation of the polynomial outcomes. -/
   137	theorem consistency_defect_ground_compress_measurement_postprocess
   138	    {γ : Type*} [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
   139	    (μ : Distribution X) (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   140	    (A : X → Quantum.Measurement α (I × K))
   141	    (B : X → Quantum.Measurement β (J × L)) (f : X → α → γ) (g : X → β → γ) :

   147	        (fun x c => heteroKron
   148	          (((groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (A x)).postprocess (f x)).effect c) 1)

   150	          (((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ (B x)).postprocess (g x)).effect c)) ψ := by
   151	  simpa only [ground_compress_measurement_postprocess] using

   153	      (fun x => (A x).postprocess (f x)) (fun x => (B x).postprocess (g x))
   154	
   155	end Bipartite
   156	
   157	/-- Compressing the existing completed Naimark dilation at `none` recovers
   158	the original POVM as a measurement, by its established effect identity. -/
   159	@[simp] theorem ground_compress_dilated_measurement
   160	    {α I : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

     3	/-!
     4	# Ground-slice compression of measurements
     5	
     6	This module restricts a POVM on a product space to one distinguished ancillary
     7	coordinate. It also records that this restriction commutes with deterministic
     8	outcome postprocessing, recovers a POVM from its one-measurement Naimark
     9	dilation, and preserves consistency defects evaluated on the correspondingly
    10	padded bipartite state.
    11	
    12	The construction supports the pullback after the first paragraph of the proof
    13	of paper `lem:qld-4-7`,
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1279-1289`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    18	
    19	namespace MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement
    20	
    21	/-- Restrict every effect of a POVM to the matrix block at one fixed ancillary
    22	coordinate. The principal submatrix of a positive semidefinite effect remains
    23	positive semidefinite, and restricting the sum of the effects restricts the
    24	identity to the identity. -/
    25	noncomputable def compressAt
    26	    {Outcome I κ : Type*}
    27	    [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    28	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    29	    (k₀ : κ) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Outcome (I × κ)) :
    30	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Outcome I :=
    31	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    32	    (fun a => (M.effect a).submatrix (fun i => (i, k₀)) (fun i => (i, k₀)))
    33	    (fun a => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
    34	      ((Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (M.pos a)).submatrix (fun i => (i, k₀))))
    35	    (by
    36	      classical
    37	      ext i j
    38	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
    39	        Prod.mk.injEq, and_true]
    40	        using congrFun (congrFun M.sum_eq_one (i, k₀)) (j, k₀))
    41	
    42	@[simp] theorem compressAt_effect
    43	    {Outcome I κ : Type*}
    44	    [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    45	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    46	    (k₀ : κ) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Outcome (I × κ)) (a : Outcome) :
    47	    (M.compressAt k₀).effect a =
    48	      (M.effect a).submatrix (fun i => (i, k₀)) (fun i => (i, k₀)) :=
    49	  rfl
    50	
    51	/-- Restricting a POVM to a fixed ancillary coordinate commutes with
    52	deterministic relabeling of its outcomes. -/
    53	theorem compressAt_postprocess
    54	    {A B I κ : Type*}
    55	    [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    56	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    57	    (k₀ : κ) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement A (I × κ)) (f : A → B) :
    58	    (M.postprocess f).compressAt k₀ = (M.compressAt k₀).postprocess f := by
    59	  classical
    60	  apply MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ext
    61	  intro b
    62	  ext i j
    63	  simp only [compressAt_effect, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    64	    Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.sum_apply]
    65	
    66	end MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement

    69

    72	namespace Measurement
    73	
    74	/-- Compressing the completed one-measurement Naimark dilation at its
    75	distinguished `none` coordinate recovers the original POVM. -/
    76	theorem compressAt_dilatedMeasurement
    77	    {A I : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    78	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    79	    (a₀ : A) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement A I) :
    80	    (dilatedMeasurement a₀ M).compressAt none = M := by
    81	  apply MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ext
    82	  intro a
    83	  ext i j
    84	  exact dilatedMeasurement_compression a₀ a M i j
    85	
    86	end Measurement

    88	/-- Ground-slice compression preserves exactly the off-diagonal consistency
    89	defect when the bipartite state is padded at the same two ancillary
    90	coordinates. This is an equality of POVM correlations and does not assert that
    91	the compressed measurements are projective. -/
    92	theorem consistencyDefect_padState_compressAt
    93	    {X Outcome I J κA κB : Type*}
    94	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    95	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
    96	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    97	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
    98	    (μ : Distribution X)
    99	    (MA : X → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Outcome (I × κA))
   100	    (MB : X → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Outcome (J × κB))
   101	    (a₀ : κA) (b₀ : κB) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) :
   102	    consistencyDefect μ
   103	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((MA x).effect a) 1)
   104	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((MB x).effect a))
   105	        (padState a₀ b₀ ψ) =
   106	      consistencyDefect μ
   107	        (fun x a => heteroKron (((MA x).compressAt a₀).effect a) 1)
   108	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (((MB x).compressAt b₀).effect a))
   109	        ψ := by
   110	  unfold consistencyDefect
   111	  apply avgOver_congr
   112	  intro x
   113	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   114	  intro a _
   115	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   116	  intro b _
   117	  by_cases hab : a = b
   118	  · simp [hab]
   119	  · simp only [hab, if_false]
   120	    change vectorQForm (padState a₀ b₀ ψ)
   121	        (heteroKron ((MA x).effect a) 1 * heteroKron 1 ((MB x).effect b)) =
   122	      vectorQForm ψ
   123	        (heteroKron (((MA x).compressAt a₀).effect a) 1 *
   124	          heteroKron 1 (((MB x).compressAt b₀).effect b))
   125	    simpa only [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul] using
   126	      stateQForm_padState a₀ b₀ ψ
   127	        (((MA x).compressAt a₀).effect a)
   128	        (((MB x).compressAt b₀).effect b)
   129	        ((MA x).effect a) ((MB x).effect b)
   130	        (fun i j => rfl) (fun i j => rfl)
   131	
   132	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

   122	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind)
   123	    (point : Fin params.m → PauliScalar params) (value : PauliScalar params) :
   124	    ((setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).postprocess
   125	      (fun poly => evalPoly poly point)).effect value =
   126	      ∑ values ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   127	          (fun values : PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params => values.1 + values.2 = value),
   128	        heteroKron ((setting.pauliEvalMeas side basis point).effect values.1)
   129	          (tauPointProj basis point values.2) := by
   130	  rw [encodingPauliMeas_postprocess_eval, Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   131	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   132	  intro values _
   133	  change heteroKron ((setting.pauliEvalMeas side basis point).effect values.1)
   134	    (((pauliRegisterMeas basis).postprocess
   135	      (fun answer => lowDegreeEnc answer point)).effect values.2) = _
   136	  simp only [Measurement.postprocess_effect, lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct]
   137	  rfl
   138	
   139	end ProjectiveSetting
   140	
   141	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

1	import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.DistanceTheorems.Support
     2	
     3	/-!
     4	# Finite controlled unitaries
     5	
     6	A complete projective measurement controls a family of operators on a second
     7	finite-dimensional space. Orthogonality of the measurement effects makes
     8	multiplication of the resulting operator sums componentwise. In particular,
     9	unitary components give a unitary controlled operator.
    10	
    11	These are formalization-only algebraic lemmas, not the extraction theorem:
    12	they do not construct the global measurement or establish the Pauli relations.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1700`,
    17	  the unitarity calculation in the proof of `lem:qld-unitary`.
    18	- Blueprint `def:v-swap-unitary` and `lem:v-swap-conjugation`.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	open scoped BigOperators Matrix
    22	
    23	namespace MIPStarRE.Quantum
    24	
    25	open MIPStarRE.QPBT
    26	
    27	variable {Outcome Control Target : Type*}
    28	variable [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype Control] [DecidableEq Control]
    29	variable [Fintype Target]
    30	
    31	/-- Multiplication of operator sums controlled by the same projective measurement
    32	is componentwise. This isolates the orthogonality calculation in the proof of
    33	`lem:qld-unitary`, before any unitarity of the controlled components is used. -/
    34	theorem sum_heteroKron_mul_sum_heteroKron
    35	    (measurement : Measurement Outcome Control)
    36	    (hprojective : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
    37	    (leftOperators rightOperators : Outcome → Op Target) :
    38	    (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (leftOperators outcome)) *
    39	        (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (rightOperators outcome)) =
    40	      ∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome)
    41	        (leftOperators outcome * rightOperators outcome) := by
    42	  classical
    43	  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    44	  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, heteroKron_mul]
    45	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    46	  intro outcome _
    47	  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single outcome]
    48	  · rw [(hprojective outcome).isIdempotentElem.eq]
    49	  · intro other _ hother
    50	    rw [DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero
    51	      measurement hprojective hother.symm]
    52	    exact Matrix.zero_kronecker _
    53	  · simp
    54	
    55	variable [DecidableEq Target]
    56	
    57	/-- A controlled operator times its adjoint is the identity when each component
    58	times its adjoint is the identity. This is the finite controlled-unitary
    59	calculation at paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1700`,
    60	with arbitrary unitary components in place of the products of Pauli observables. -/
    61	theorem sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose
    62	    (measurement : Measurement Outcome Control)
    63	    (hprojective : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
    64	    (operators : Outcome → Op Target)
    65	    (hunitary : ∀ outcome, operators outcome * (operators outcome)ᴴ = 1) :
    66	    (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) *
    67	        (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome))ᴴ = 1 := by
    68	  have hself (outcome : Outcome) :
    69	      (measurement.effect outcome)ᴴ = measurement.effect outcome :=
    70	    (hprojective outcome).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
    71	  calc
    72	    _ = (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) *
    73	        (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) ((operators outcome)ᴴ)) := by
    74	      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
    75	        Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, hself]
    76	    _ = ∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome)
    77	        (operators outcome * (operators outcome)ᴴ) :=
    78	      sum_heteroKron_mul_sum_heteroKron measurement hprojective _ _
    79	    _ = ∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (1 : Op Target) := by
    80	      simp_rw [hunitary]
    81	    _ = 1 := by
    82	      rw [← DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left, measurement.sum_eq_one,
    83	        heteroKron_one_one]
    84	
    85	/-- The reverse adjoint product of a controlled operator is also the identity.
    86	For finite square matrices, Mathlib's `mul_eq_one_comm` converts either inverse
    87	identity to the other, both for the components and for the controlled operator.
    88	This supplies the reverse identity implicit in the same source calculation. -/
    89	theorem conjTranspose_mul_sum_heteroKron
    90	    (measurement : Measurement Outcome Control)
    91	    (hprojective : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
    92	    (operators : Outcome → Op Target)
    93	    (hunitary : ∀ outcome, (operators outcome)ᴴ * operators outcome = 1) :
    94	    (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome))ᴴ *
    95	        (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) = 1 := by
    96	  apply mul_eq_one_comm.mp
    97	  apply sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose measurement hprojective operators
    98	  intro outcome
    99	  exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp (hunitary outcome)
   100	
   101	/-- A finite sum of unitary operators controlled by a complete projective
   102	measurement is unitary. The hypotheses concern the actual component operators;
   103	no unitarity or extraction conclusion is assumed for their controlled sum. -/
   104	theorem sum_heteroKron_mem_unitary
   105	    (measurement : Measurement Outcome Control)
   106	    (hprojective : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
   107	    (operators : Outcome → Op Target)
   108	    (hunitary : ∀ outcome, operators outcome ∈ unitary (Op Target)) :
   109	    (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) ∈
   110	      unitary (Op (Control × Target)) := by
   111	  exact ⟨conjTranspose_mul_sum_heteroKron measurement hprojective operators
   112	      (fun outcome => (hunitary outcome).1),
   113	    sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose measurement hprojective operators
   114	      (fun outcome => (hunitary outcome).2)⟩
   115	
   116	end MIPStarRE.Quantum

1	import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Algebra.PauliTheorems
     2	import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Soundness
     3	
     4	/-!
     5	# Qubit form of Pauli basis test soundness
     6	
     7	The fixed self-dual normal basis converts the qudit EPR register and generalized
     8	Pauli projectors into qubit coordinates. The conversion uses only the basis
     9	stored in the canonical `FixedFieldModel`.
    10	
    11	`PauliSoundnessWitness.toQubit` transports supplied existential data, and the
    12	three `qubit_*_to_qubit` identities preserve its comparison quantities exactly.
    13	These are Lean-only transport results, not soundness existence theorems. This
    14	module derives `pauli_soundness_qubit` from `pauli_soundness` using those identities.
    15	The corollary still depends on the unfinished proof of `pauli_soundness` (issue #529).
    16	
    17	## References
    18	
    19	The conversion is blueprint
    20	`lem:pauli-binary`, from
    21	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1163-1208`. The resulting
    22	statement is blueprint `cor:pauli-binary`,
    23	from `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1450-1491`.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	open scoped BigOperators Matrix
    27	
    28	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    29	
    30	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.Quantum
    31	
    32	noncomputable section
    33	
    34	/-- The bit register obtained by expanding every Pauli-register field element
    35	in the basis stored by `P.model`. -/
    36	abbrev QubitRegister (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
    37	  Cube P.m × Fin P.model.basisDim → ZMod 2
    38	
    39	/-- The ideal auxiliary state tensored with the qubit EPR register, in the
    40	local-player ordering used by `cor:pauli-binary`. -/
    41	noncomputable def idealQubitState (P : AdmissibleParams)
    42	    {ιA' ιB' : Type*} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
    43	    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB']
    44	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA' × ιB')) :
    45	    EuclideanSpace ℂ
    46	      ((ιA' × QubitRegister P) × (ιB' × QubitRegister P)) :=
    47	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv
    48	      ((ιA' × QubitRegister P) × (ιB' × QubitRegister P)) ℂ).symm
    49	    (fun p =>
    50	      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ιA' × ιB') ℂ aux (p.1.1, p.2.1)) *
    51	        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (QubitRegister P × QubitRegister P) ℂ
    52	          (eprState (QubitRegister P)) (p.1.2, p.2.2)))
    53	
    54	/-- The local isometries, auxiliary spaces, and unit auxiliary state in
    55	`cor:pauli-binary`; this structure introduces no hypothesis beyond the paper
    56	theorem. -/
    57	structure QubitSoundnessWitness (P : AdmissibleParams)
    58	    (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) where
    59	  ιA' : Type
    60	  ιB' : Type
    61	  [ιAFintype : Fintype ιA']
    62	  [ιBFintype : Fintype ιB']
    63	  [ιADecidableEq : DecidableEq ιA']
    64	  [ιBDecidableEq : DecidableEq ιB']
    65	  φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ]
    66	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA' × QubitRegister P)
    67	  φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ]
    68	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιB' × QubitRegister P)
    69	  aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA' × ιB')
    70	  aux_norm : ‖aux‖ = 1
    71	
    72	attribute [instance] QubitSoundnessWitness.ιAFintype
    73	  QubitSoundnessWitness.ιBFintype QubitSoundnessWitness.ιADecidableEq
    74	  QubitSoundnessWitness.ιBDecidableEq
    75	
    76	/-- Alice's ideal qubit projector placed on the joint target space. -/
    77	noncomputable def qubitProjOnA'' (P : AdmissibleParams)
    78	    {ιA' ιB' : Type*} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
    79	    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB'] (W : PauliKind)
    80	    (u : PauliRegister P) :
    81	    Op ((ιA' × QubitRegister P) × (ιB' × QubitRegister P)) :=
    82	  fun p q =>
    83	    if p.1.1 = q.1.1 ∧ p.2 = q.2 then
    84	      qubitPauliProj W (kappaVec P.model u) p.1.2 q.1.2
    85	    else 0
    86	
    87	/-- Bob's ideal qubit projector placed on the joint target space. -/
    88	noncomputable def qubitProjOnB'' (P : AdmissibleParams)
    89	    {ιA' ιB' : Type*} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
    90	    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB'] (W : PauliKind)
    91	    (u : PauliRegister P) :
    92	    Op ((ιA' × QubitRegister P) × (ιB' × QubitRegister P)) :=
    93	  fun p q =>
    94	    if p.1 = q.1 ∧ p.2.1 = q.2.1 then
    95	      qubitPauliProj W (kappaVec P.model u) p.2.2 q.2.2
    96	    else 0
    97	
    98	/-- Lift a conjugated Alice effect to the full qubit target space. -/
    99	noncomputable def liftedQubitAEffect {P : AdmissibleParams} {G : Game}
   100	    (S : Strategy G) {ιA' ιB' : Type*} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
   101	    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB']
   102	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ]
   103	      EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA' × QubitRegister P))
   104	    (M : Op S.ιA) :
   105	    Op ((ιA' × QubitRegister P) × (ιB' × QubitRegister P)) :=
   106	  heteroKron (conjIsometry φA M) 1
   107	
   108	/-- Lift a conjugated Bob effect to the full qubit target space. -/
   109	noncomputable def liftedQubitBEffect {P : AdmissibleParams} {G : Game}
   110	    (S : Strategy G) {ιA' ιB' : Type*} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
   111	    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB']
   112	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ]
   113	      EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιB' × QubitRegister P))
   114	    (M : Op S.ιB) :
   115	    Op ((ιA' × QubitRegister P) × (ιB' × QubitRegister P)) :=
   116	  heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB M)
   117	
   118	/-- Alice's qubit-projector family distance in `cor:pauli-binary`. -/
   119	noncomputable def qubitOperatorDistanceA
   120	    (P : AdmissibleParams) (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P))
   121	    (w : QubitSoundnessWitness P S) (W : PauliKind) : ℝ :=
   122	  ∑ u : PauliRegister P,
   123	    ‖applyOperatorToState
   124	      (liftedQubitAEffect S w.φA
   125	          (((S.A (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect u) -
   126	        qubitProjOnA'' P W u)
   127	      (idealQubitState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2
   128	
   129	/-- Bob's qubit-projector family distance in `cor:pauli-binary`. -/
   130	noncomputable def qubitOperatorDistanceB
   131	    (P : AdmissibleParams) (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P))
   132	    (w : QubitSoundnessWitness P S) (W : PauliKind) : ℝ :=
   133	  ∑ u : PauliRegister P,
   134	    ‖applyOperatorToState
   135	      (liftedQubitBEffect S w.φB
   136	          (((S.B (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect u) -
   137	        qubitProjOnB'' P W u)
   138	      (idealQubitState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2
   139	
   140	namespace BinaryWitnessTransport
   141	
   142	/-- Exact forward transport of a generalized Pauli projector to the existing
   143	binary projector. This reorients the shared arbitrary-index calculation
   144	`pauliProj_reindex_quditQubitLabelEquiv` from `lem:pauli-binary`, without a
   145	second Fourier-inversion proof or a soundness hypothesis. -/
   146	theorem pauli_projector_reindex {q : ℕ} {ι : Type*}
   147	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (F : FixedFieldModel q)
   148	    (W : PauliKind) (label : ι → F.K) :
   149	    Matrix.reindex (quditQubitLabelEquiv F) (quditQubitLabelEquiv F) (pauliProj W label) =
   150	      qubitPauliProj W (kappaVec F label) := by
   151	  classical
   152	  have hinverse := pauliProj_reindex_quditQubitLabelEquiv F W label
   153	  ext row col
   154	  simpa only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
   155	    Equiv.symm_symm, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using
   156	    congrFun (congrFun hinverse ((quditQubitLabelEquiv F).symm row))
   157	      ((quditQubitLabelEquiv F).symm col)
   158	
   159	/-- Reindexing a vector agrees with Mathlib's Euclidean permutation isometry. -/
   160	theorem reindex_state_eq {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   161	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (equiv : ι ≃ κ) (state : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   162	    reindexState equiv state = LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ equiv state := rfl
   163	
   164	/-- Simultaneous coordinate transport intertwines matrix action on a state. -/
   165	theorem operator_action_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   166	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (equiv : ι ≃ κ) (operator : Op ι)
   167	    (state : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   168	    applyOperatorToState (Matrix.reindex equiv equiv operator) (reindexState equiv state) =
   169	      reindexState equiv (applyOperatorToState operator state) := by
   170	  ext position
   171	  change (operator.submatrix equiv.symm equiv.symm *ᵥ
   172	      (fun index => state (equiv.symm index))) position =
   173	    (operator *ᵥ (fun index => state index)) (equiv.symm position)
   174	  rw [Matrix.submatrix_mulVec_equiv]
   175	  simp [Function.comp_def]
   176	
   177	/-- Simultaneous transport of two operators and their reference state preserves
   178	the norm of their difference applied to that state. -/
   179	theorem operator_error_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   180	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (equiv : ι ≃ κ) (left right : Op ι)
   181	    (state : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   182	    ‖applyOperatorToState (Matrix.reindex equiv equiv left -
   183	        Matrix.reindex equiv equiv right) (reindexState equiv state)‖ =
   184	      ‖applyOperatorToState (left - right) state‖ := by
   185	  change ‖applyOperatorToState (Matrix.reindex equiv equiv (left - right))
   186	    (reindexState equiv state)‖ = _
   187	  rw [operator_action_reindex, reindexState_norm_eq]
   188	
   189	/-- The paired EPR vector is invariant under simultaneous computational-basis
   190	relabeling. This uses a permutation, not an arbitrary complex unitary. -/
   191	theorem epr_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
   192	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Nonempty κ] (equiv : ι ≃ κ) :
   193	    reindexState (Equiv.prodCongr equiv equiv) (eprState ι) = eprState κ := by
   194	  ext position
   195	  change (if equiv.symm position.1 = equiv.symm position.2 then
   196	      (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0) =
   197	    if position.1 = position.2 then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0
   198	  rw [Fintype.card_congr equiv]
   199	  simp only [Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]
   200	
   201	/-- Post-composing both local maps with coordinate permutations reindexes their
   202	joint image. This is the permutation specialization of local isometry composition. -/
   203	theorem tensor_reindex_comp {ιA ιB κA κB νA νB : Type*}
   204	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   205	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   206	    [Fintype νA] [DecidableEq νA] [Fintype νB] [DecidableEq νB]
   207	    (equivA : κA ≃ νA) (equivB : κB ≃ νB)
   208	    (mapA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   209	    (mapB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   210	    (state : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   211	    isometryTensor
   212	        ((LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ equivA).toLinearIsometry.comp mapA)
   213	        ((LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ equivB).toLinearIsometry.comp mapB)
   214	        state = reindexState (Equiv.prodCongr equivA equivB)
   215	          (isometryTensor mapA mapB state) := rfl
   216	
   217	/-- Conjugation by a post-composed local coordinate permutation is matrix
   218	reindexing of the original conjugated effect. -/
   219	theorem conjugate_reindex_comp {ι κ ν : Type*}
   220	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
   221	    [Fintype ν] [DecidableEq ν] (equiv : κ ≃ ν)
   222	    (map : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) (operator : Op ι) :
   223	    conjIsometry
   224	        ((LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ equiv).toLinearIsometry.comp map)
   225	        operator = Matrix.reindex equiv equiv (conjIsometry map operator) := by
   226	  ext row col
   227	  rfl
   228	
   229	/-- The local label equivalence leaves the auxiliary coordinate unchanged. -/
   230	noncomputable def localEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) (auxIndex : Type*) :
   231	    (auxIndex × PauliRegister P) ≃ (auxIndex × QubitRegister P) :=
   232	  Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl auxIndex) (quditQubitLabelEquiv P.model)
   233	
   234	/-- The two local coordinate equivalences, in the existing player ordering. -/
   235	noncomputable def jointEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) (auxA auxB : Type*) :
   236	    ((auxA × PauliRegister P) × (auxB × PauliRegister P)) ≃
   237	      ((auxA × QubitRegister P) × (auxB × QubitRegister P)) :=
   238	  Equiv.prodCongr (localEquiv P auxA) (localEquiv P auxB)
   239	
   240	/-- Binary reindexing preserves the auxiliary factor and transports the EPR
   241	factor exactly after the four-factor shuffle into local-player order. -/
   242	theorem ideal_state_reindex (P : AdmissibleParams)
   243	    {auxA auxB : Type*} [Fintype auxA] [DecidableEq auxA]
   244	    [Fintype auxB] [DecidableEq auxB] (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (auxA × auxB)) :
   245	    reindexState (jointEquiv P auxA auxB) (idealState P aux) = idealQubitState P aux := by
   246	  ext position
   247	  exact congrArg (fun state : EuclideanSpace ℂ (QubitRegister P × QubitRegister P) =>
   248	    aux (position.1.1, position.2.1) * state (position.1.2, position.2.2))
   249	    (epr_reindex (quditQubitLabelEquiv (ι := Cube P.m) P.model))
   250	
   251	/-- Forward binary transport of Alice's lifted effect, including the identity
   252	on Bob's entire local register. -/
   253	theorem lifted_effect_a_reindex {P : AdmissibleParams} {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   254	    {auxA auxB : Type*} [Fintype auxA] [DecidableEq auxA]
   255	    [Fintype auxB] [DecidableEq auxB]
   256	    (mapA : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (auxA × PauliRegister P))
   257	    (operator : Op S.ιA) :
   258	    Matrix.reindex (jointEquiv P auxA auxB) (jointEquiv P auxA auxB)
   259	        (liftedAEffect S mapA operator) =
   260	      liftedQubitAEffect S
   261	        ((LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ
   262	          (localEquiv P auxA)).toLinearIsometry.comp mapA) operator := by
   263	  classical
   264	  rw [liftedQubitAEffect, conjugate_reindex_comp]
   265	  ext row col
   266	  change (if (localEquiv P auxB).symm row.2 = (localEquiv P auxB).symm col.2 then
   267	      conjIsometry mapA operator ((localEquiv P auxA).symm row.1)
   268	        ((localEquiv P auxA).symm col.1) else 0) =
   269	    conjIsometry mapA operator ((localEquiv P auxA).symm row.1)
   270	      ((localEquiv P auxA).symm col.1) * (if row.2 = col.2 then 1 else 0)
   271	  simp only [Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
   272	
   273	/-- Forward binary transport of Bob's lifted effect, including the identity
   274	on Alice's entire local register. -/
   275	theorem lifted_effect_b_reindex {P : AdmissibleParams} {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   276	    {auxA auxB : Type*} [Fintype auxA] [DecidableEq auxA]
   277	    [Fintype auxB] [DecidableEq auxB]
   278	    (mapB : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (auxB × PauliRegister P))
   279	    (operator : Op S.ιB) :
   280	    Matrix.reindex (jointEquiv P auxA auxB) (jointEquiv P auxA auxB)
   281	        (liftedBEffect S mapB operator) =
   282	      liftedQubitBEffect S
   283	        ((LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ
   284	          (localEquiv P auxB)).toLinearIsometry.comp mapB) operator := by
   285	  classical
   286	  rw [liftedQubitBEffect, conjugate_reindex_comp]
   287	  ext row col
   288	  change (if (localEquiv P auxA).symm row.1 = (localEquiv P auxA).symm col.1 then
   289	      conjIsometry mapB operator ((localEquiv P auxB).symm row.2)
   290	        ((localEquiv P auxB).symm col.2) else 0) =
   291	    (if row.1 = col.1 then 1 else 0) *
   292	      conjIsometry mapB operator ((localEquiv P auxB).symm row.2)
   293	        ((localEquiv P auxB).symm col.2)
   294	  simp only [Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
   295	
   296	/-- Forward binary transport of the ideal projector on Alice's extracted
   297	register, with the other three tensor factors fixed. -/
   298	theorem ideal_projector_a_reindex (P : AdmissibleParams)
   299	    {auxA auxB : Type*} [Fintype auxA] [DecidableEq auxA]
   300	    [Fintype auxB] [DecidableEq auxB] (W : PauliKind) (label : PauliRegister P) :
   301	    Matrix.reindex (jointEquiv P auxA auxB) (jointEquiv P auxA auxB)
   302	        (pauliProjOnA'' P W label) = qubitProjOnA'' P W label := by
   303	  classical
   304	  ext row col
   305	  change (if row.1.1 = col.1.1 ∧
   306	      (localEquiv P auxB).symm row.2 = (localEquiv P auxB).symm col.2 then
   307	      (Matrix.reindex (quditQubitLabelEquiv P.model) (quditQubitLabelEquiv P.model)
   308	        (pauliProj W label)) row.1.2 col.1.2 else 0) =
   309	    if row.1.1 = col.1.1 ∧ row.2 = col.2 then
   310	      qubitPauliProj W (kappaVec P.model label) row.1.2 col.1.2 else 0
   311	  rw [pauli_projector_reindex]
   312	  simp only [Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]
   313	
   314	/-- Forward binary transport of the ideal projector on Bob's extracted
   315	register, with the other three tensor factors fixed. -/
   316	theorem ideal_projector_b_reindex (P : AdmissibleParams)
   317	    {auxA auxB : Type*} [Fintype auxA] [DecidableEq auxA]
   318	    [Fintype auxB] [DecidableEq auxB] (W : PauliKind) (label : PauliRegister P) :
   319	    Matrix.reindex (jointEquiv P auxA auxB) (jointEquiv P auxA auxB)
   320	        (pauliProjOnB'' P W label) = qubitProjOnB'' P W label := by
   321	  classical
   322	  ext row col
   323	  change (if (localEquiv P auxA).symm row.1 = (localEquiv P auxA).symm col.1 ∧
   324	      row.2.1 = col.2.1 then
   325	      (Matrix.reindex (quditQubitLabelEquiv P.model) (quditQubitLabelEquiv P.model)
   326	        (pauliProj W label)) row.2.2 col.2.2 else 0) =
   327	    if row.1 = col.1 ∧ row.2.1 = col.2.1 then
   328	      qubitPauliProj W (kappaVec P.model label) row.2.2 col.2.2 else 0
   329	  rw [pauli_projector_reindex]
   330	  simp only [Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]
   331	
   332	end BinaryWitnessTransport
   333	
   334	/-- Convert a supplied Pauli witness by post-composing each extraction map with
   335	the fixed binary coordinate permutation. The auxiliary spaces, vector, and
   336	normalization proof are unchanged. This is the exact given-witness construction
   337	in the proof of `cor:pauli-binary`, not a proof of soundness existence. -/
   338	noncomputable def PauliSoundnessWitness.toQubit
   339	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)}
   340	    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P S) : QubitSoundnessWitness P S where
   341	  ιA' := w.ιA'
   342	  ιB' := w.ιB'
   343	  φA := (LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ
   344	    (BinaryWitnessTransport.localEquiv P w.ιA')).toLinearIsometry.comp w.φA
   345	  φB := (LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ
   346	    (BinaryWitnessTransport.localEquiv P w.ιB')).toLinearIsometry.comp w.φB
   347	  aux := w.aux
   348	  aux_norm := w.aux_norm
   349	
   350	/-- Exact preservation of state error for a supplied witness. This Lean-only
   351	transport identity has no success assumption or error bound and does not assert
   352	the existence conclusion of `cor:pauli-binary`. -/
   353	theorem qubit_state_error_to_qubit
   354	    (P : AdmissibleParams) (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P))
   355	    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P S) :
   356	    ‖isometryTensor w.toQubit.φA w.toQubit.φB S.ψ -
   357	        idealQubitState P w.toQubit.aux‖ =
   358	      ‖isometryTensor w.φA w.φB S.ψ - idealState P w.aux‖ := by
   359	  change ‖isometryTensor
   360	      ((LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ
   361	        (BinaryWitnessTransport.localEquiv P w.ιA')).toLinearIsometry.comp w.φA)
   362	      ((LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ
   363	        (BinaryWitnessTransport.localEquiv P w.ιB')).toLinearIsometry.comp w.φB)
   364	      S.ψ - idealQubitState P w.aux‖ = _
   365	  rw [BinaryWitnessTransport.tensor_reindex_comp,
   366	    ← BinaryWitnessTransport.ideal_state_reindex]
   367	  rw [BinaryWitnessTransport.reindex_state_eq, BinaryWitnessTransport.reindex_state_eq]
   368	  rw [BinaryWitnessTransport.jointEquiv, ← map_sub, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
   369	
   370	/-- Exact preservation of Alice's squared operator-family distance for a
   371	supplied witness. The answer sum is still field-valued, and both distances are
   372	evaluated on their ideal auxiliary-EPR state. No soundness bound is assumed. -/
   373	theorem qubit_operator_distance_a_to_qubit
   374	    (P : AdmissibleParams) (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P))
   375	    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P S) (W : PauliKind) :
   376	    qubitOperatorDistanceA P S w.toQubit W = pauliOperatorDistanceA P S w W := by
   377	  unfold qubitOperatorDistanceA pauliOperatorDistanceA
   378	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun label _ => ?_
   379	  have hnorm := BinaryWitnessTransport.operator_error_reindex
   380	    (BinaryWitnessTransport.jointEquiv P w.ιA' w.ιB')
   381	    (liftedAEffect S w.φA
   382	      (((S.A (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect label))
   383	    (pauliProjOnA'' P W label) (idealState P w.aux)
   384	  rw [BinaryWitnessTransport.lifted_effect_a_reindex,
   385	    BinaryWitnessTransport.ideal_projector_a_reindex,
   386	    BinaryWitnessTransport.ideal_state_reindex] at hnorm
   387	  exact congrArg (fun error : ℝ => error ^ 2) hnorm
   388	
   389	/-- Exact preservation of Bob's squared operator-family distance for a supplied
   390	witness. This is a given-witness transport identity, independent of the open
   391	existence conclusion of `cor:pauli-binary`. -/
   392	theorem qubit_operator_distance_b_to_qubit
   393	    (P : AdmissibleParams) (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P))
   394	    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P S) (W : PauliKind) :
   395	    qubitOperatorDistanceB P S w.toQubit W = pauliOperatorDistanceB P S w W := by
   396	  unfold qubitOperatorDistanceB pauliOperatorDistanceB
   397	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun label _ => ?_
   398	  have hnorm := BinaryWitnessTransport.operator_error_reindex
   399	    (BinaryWitnessTransport.jointEquiv P w.ιA' w.ιB')
   400	    (liftedBEffect S w.φB
   401	      (((S.B (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect label))
   402	    (pauliProjOnB'' P W label) (idealState P w.aux)
   403	  rw [BinaryWitnessTransport.lifted_effect_b_reindex,
   404	    BinaryWitnessTransport.ideal_projector_b_reindex,
   405	    BinaryWitnessTransport.ideal_state_reindex] at hnorm
   406	  exact congrArg (fun error : ℝ => error ^ 2) hnorm
   407	
   408	/-- `cor:pauli-binary`: soundness of the Pauli basis test in qubit
   409	coordinates. Blueprint `cor:pauli-binary`, paper
   410	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1450-1491`.
   411	
   412	The theorem assumes a nonnegative error parameter, as in the source, and uses
   413	only `P.model` and its stored basis dimension.
   414	
   415	**Proof dependency:** The coordinate change and all three error identities are
   416	proved, but the source theorem `pauli_soundness` remains an open proof obligation
   417	(issue #529). Completing that theorem from `thm:pauli`'s hypotheses is required
   418	to certify this corollary; no proof-completeness claim is made here. -/
   419	theorem pauli_soundness_qubit :
   420	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b < 1 ∧
   421	      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ ε →
   422	        ∀ S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P), 1 - ε ≤ S.value →
   423	          ∃ w : QubitSoundnessWitness P S,
   424	            ‖isometryTensor w.φA w.φB S.ψ - idealQubitState P w.aux‖ ≤
   425	                deltaQld a b ε P.m P.d P.q ∧
   426	            (∀ W : PauliKind,
   427	              qubitOperatorDistanceA P S w W ≤
   428	                deltaQld a b ε P.m P.d P.q) ∧
   429	            ∀ W : PauliKind,
   430	              qubitOperatorDistanceB P S w W ≤
   431	                deltaQld a b ε P.m P.d P.q := by
   432	  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb_one, hsound⟩ := pauli_soundness
   433	  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb_one, ?_⟩
   434	  intro P ε hε S hS
   435	  obtain ⟨w, hstate, hA, hB⟩ := hsound P ε hε S hS
   436	  refine ⟨w.toQubit, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   437	  · exact (qubit_state_error_to_qubit P S w).trans_le hstate
   438	  · intro W
   439	    exact (qubit_operator_distance_a_to_qubit P S w W).trans_le (hA W)
   440	  · intro W
   441	    exact (qubit_operator_distance_b_to_qubit P S w W).trans_le (hB W)
   442	
   443	end

     7	/-!
     8	# A uniform point of the extended space from the sub-line law
     9	
    10	The first scalar estimate in the combining argument samples an extended line
    11	from the sub-line witness and then a uniform affine parameter on that line.
    12	This module records that the resulting extended point is uniform and hence
    13	that its two source coordinate blocks are independent uniform points.
    14	
    15	## References
    16	
    17	These statements support `lem:claim-17-1` in
    18	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`.  The paper uses this sampling
    19	fact at
    20	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1159-1166`.
    21	-/

    31	/-- If every slice of a map of a pair carries the second uniform law to one
    32	fixed law, then the map carries the uniform law of the pair to that law. -/
    33	theorem uniformDistribution_map_uncurry {α β γ : Type*}
    34	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    35	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] [DecidableEq γ]
    36	    (g : α × β → γ) (ν : Distribution γ)
    37	    (hg : ∀ a, (uniformDistribution β).map (fun b => g (a, b)) = ν) :
    38	    (uniformDistribution (α × β)).map g = ν := by
    39	  rw [← bind_uniformDistribution_map (fun a b => g (a, b)),
    40	    show (fun a => (uniformDistribution β).map (fun b => g (a, b))) =
    41	      fun _ => ν from funext hg]
    42	  exact Distribution.bind_const _ (uniformDistribution_isProbability α) ν
    43	
    44	/-- Reading a point at a uniform affine parameter on the canonical line of a
    45	uniform direct sample gives a uniform point of the direct coordinate space. -/
    46	theorem uniformDistribution_map_directLine_add_smul (D : DirectLdParams)
    47	    (V : Fin D.m × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) :
    48	    (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D × DirectScalarQ D)).map
    49	        (fun p => lineRepMap (V (p.1.index, p.1.direction)) p.1.point +
    50	          p.2 • V (p.1.index, p.1.direction)) =
    51	      uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) := by
    52	  classical
    53	  let e : DirectLdSpace D × DirectScalarQ D ≃
    54	      (Fin D.m × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) ×
    55	        ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × DirectScalarQ D) :=
    56	    { toFun := fun p => ((p.1.index, p.1.direction), (p.1.point, p.2))
    57	      invFun := fun w => (⟨w.2.1, w.1.1, w.1.2⟩, w.2.2)
    58	      left_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨pt, i, dir⟩, t⟩; rfl
    59	      right_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨i, dir⟩, pt, t⟩; rfl }
    60	  have hequiv :
    61	      (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D × DirectScalarQ D)).map e =
    62	        uniformDistribution ((Fin D.m × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) ×
    63	          ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × DirectScalarQ D)) :=
    64	    uniformDistribution_map_equiv e
    65	  have hmap :
    66	      (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D × DirectScalarQ D)).map
    67	          (fun p => lineRepMap (V (p.1.index, p.1.direction)) p.1.point +
    68	            p.2 • V (p.1.index, p.1.direction)) =
    69	        ((uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D × DirectScalarQ D)).map e).map
    70	          (fun w => lineRepMap (V w.1) w.2.1 + w.2.2 • V w.1) := by
    71	    rw [Distribution.map_map]
    72	    rfl
    73	  rw [hmap, hequiv]
    74	  refine uniformDistribution_map_uncurry _ _ fun a => ?_
    75	  exact uniformDistribution_map_lineRepMap_add_smul (V a)

    77	/-- Averaging a function at a uniform affine parameter on the canonical line
    78	of a uniform direct sample is averaging it at a uniform point. -/
    79	theorem avgOver_uniform_directLdSpace_line_add_smul (D : DirectLdParams)
    80	    (V : Fin D.m × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
    81	    (g : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ) :
    82	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D)) (fun s =>
    83	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ D)) (fun t =>
    84	          g (lineRepMap (V (s.index, s.direction)) s.point +
    85	            t • V (s.index, s.direction)))) =
    86	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) g := by
    87	  classical
    88	  rw [← avgOver_uniform_prod]
    89	  calc
    90	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D × DirectScalarQ D))
    91	          (fun p => g (lineRepMap (V (p.1.index, p.1.direction)) p.1.point +
    92	            p.2 • V (p.1.index, p.1.direction))) =
    93	        avgOver ((uniformDistribution
    94	            (DirectLdSpace D × DirectScalarQ D)).map
    95	          (fun p => lineRepMap (V (p.1.index, p.1.direction)) p.1.point +
    96	            p.2 • V (p.1.index, p.1.direction))) g :=
    97	      (Distribution.avgOver_map _ _ g).symm
    98	    _ = avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) g := by
    99	      rw [uniformDistribution_map_directLine_add_smul]

   116	    exact avgOver_uniform_directLdSpace_line_add_smul D

   130	/-- Identify the directly indexed extended coordinates with the combining
   131	coordinate split. -/
   132	private def extendedFinCombineEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   133	    Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m ≃ ((Fin P.m ⊕ Fin P.m) ⊕ Fin 2) :=
   134	  (finCongr (by rfl)).trans (finCombineEquiv P.m)
   135	
   136	/-- Split an extended point into its two source blocks and two remaining
   137	scalar coordinates. -/
   138	private noncomputable def extendedPointBlocksEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   139	    (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ≃
   140	      ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) ×
   141	        (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :=
   142	  (Equiv.arrowCongr (extendedFinCombineEquiv P)
   143	      (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P)).trans
   144	    ((Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow (Fin P.m ⊕ Fin P.m) (Fin 2)
   145	      (PauliScalar P)).trans
   146	      (Equiv.prodCongr
   147	        (Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow (Fin P.m) (Fin P.m) (PauliScalar P))
   148	        (Equiv.refl (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P))))

   150	/-- The two source blocks of a uniform extended point are independent and
   151	uniform after the canonical scalar identification. -/
   152	private theorem uniformDistribution_map_projX_projZ_pauli_current
   153	    (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   154	    (uniformDistribution
   155	          (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)).map
   156	        (fun u => (projX (directPointToPauli P u),
   157	          projZ (directPointToPauli P u))) =
   158	      uniformDistribution
   159	        ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) := by
   160	  classical
   161	  apply uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv (extendedPointBlocksEquiv P)
   162	  intro u
   163	  apply Prod.ext <;> funext i <;> rfl

   165	/-- Under a sub-line witness, the two source blocks of the point at a uniform
   166	affine parameter are independent uniform source points. -/
   167	theorem SubLineWitness.avgOver_projX_projZ (P : AdmissibleParams)
   168	    (sublines : SubLineWitness P)
   169	    (f : ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) → ℝ) :
   170	    avgOver sublines.D (fun sample =>
   171	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))
   172	          (fun t =>
   173	            f (projX (directPointToPauli P
   174	                (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction)),
   175	              projZ (directPointToPauli P
   176	                (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction))))) =
   177	      avgOver (uniformDistribution
   178	        ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))) f := by
   179	  classical
   180	  have hmarginal :
   181	      avgOver sublines.D (fun sample =>
   182	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))
   183	            (fun t => f (projX (directPointToPauli P
   184	                (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction)),
   185	              projZ (directPointToPauli P
   186	                (sample.1.base + t • sample.1.direction))))) =
   187	        avgOver ((directLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd).map Prod.fst)
   188	          (fun line =>
   189	            avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))
   190	              (fun t => f (projX (directPointToPauli P
   191	                  (line.base + t • line.direction)),
   192	                projZ (directPointToPauli P
   193	                  (line.base + t • line.direction))))) := by
   194	    rw [← sublines.extended_marginal, Distribution.avgOver_map]
   195	  refine hmarginal.trans ?_
   196	  refine (avgOver_directLinePointDist_line_add_smul P.extendedDirectLd
   197	    (fun u => f (projX (directPointToPauli P u),
   198	      projZ (directPointToPauli P u)))).trans ?_
   199	  rw [← uniformDistribution_map_projX_projZ_pauli_current,
   200	    Distribution.avgOver_map]
   201	
   202	end

     5	
     6	This formalization-only auxiliary constructs a complete measurement supported on
     7	the good outcomes of a finite measurement, by sending every bad outcome to a
     8	specified good outcome. For projective measurements this adds the complementary
     9	projection to the default effect and preserves projectivity. The consistency
    10	estimates charge changes of outcome labels only to the state mass of that
    11	complementary projection, on either of two possibly different player spaces.

    14	combining map is the unimplemented target `global_polynomial_bad_mass_le`,
    15	specified in `audits/2026-09-06_supported-projective-completion.md` under issue #279.
    16	No result here asserts the global polynomial-pair theorem or derives that estimate.

    39	/-- Retain every good outcome and send every other outcome to the specified
    40	good outcome. The default is actual domain data, with its membership proof. -/
    41	def toGood (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
    42	    (a₀ : {a // good a}) (a : α) : {a // good a} :=
    43	  if h : good a then ⟨a, h⟩ else a₀

    50	/-- The omitted effects. When the measurement is projective, their sum is the
    51	projection complementary to the sum of good effects. -/
    52	noncomputable def badEffect (M : Measurement α ι)
    53	    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] : Op ι :=
    54	  ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => ¬ good a), M.effect a
